market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: CL settlement ≥$120 by end of June requires ~14-19% upside from $101-105 current. Hormuz tensions provide upside, but ~$120 needs full Hormuz closure or escalation. ~2 months runway. Estimate ~18%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Major escalation could spike prices fast
